meta.title: Interface experience
meta.description: Make the DSH interface follow the Material You palette matugen generates on the system. After enabling Settings → General → Matugen palette sync, the palette is layered over the current theme and follows the file whenever matugen regenerates it. Expand Palette file paths on the same row to rewrite the matugen colors file or the DSH token file path (both default under ~/.local/state/quickshell/user/generated/, the token file wins when present). Palette files are read locally and never uploaded; turning the switch off returns the native colors. Also unifies the interface border width (config option borderWidth, default 0.5px); that override applies only while the switch is on and narrows decorative borders such as markdown quote rules. A separate M3 motion row rewrites every transition and keyframe animation in the interface onto Material 3 / Material 3 Expressive curves, in place, with its own curve family, duration scale, duration snapping, and reduced-motion policy; the rewrite reaches styles injected by other plugins and restores everything exactly when switched off. The same row also takes over smooth scrolling (including wheel easing) and the progressive reveal of streamed text: no character is truncated, only a mask moves, so selection, copying, and screen readers are unaffected.
